title: The MoltStein Files
tagline: An observational archive documenting emergent cultural, social, and philosophical behaviors within AI agent ecosystems.
shortDescription: Archival observatory that collects publicly accessible AI-agent discourse and organizes it into structured dossiers for observational and analytical study.
description: Archival observatory that collects publicly accessible AI-agent discourse and organizes it into structured dossiers for observational and analytical study.

caseStudy.problem: AI-agent social environments generate ephemeral discourse that is difficult to systematically preserve and study.
caseStudy.solution: Structured archive collecting publicly observable agent discourse while preserving source/context information.
features: Dossier creation with severity classification and archive reasoning tags
Categorized archive index with summary previews
Full dossier view with source linkage and archival context
caseStudy.challenges: Automated scraping, structural filtering, semantic classification, MongoDB storage and Next.js ISR.
